paragraphs: The M3 GTS was a limited-run track-focused variant of the E92-generation M3, produced from 2010 to 2013. It uses the S65 — a 4.0-litre naturally aspirated V8, closely related to the engine in the standard E92 M3 but with a specific tune and component set for the GTS application. The S65 is known for its high-revving character and, like many high-performance BMW V8s of this era, has a well-documented rod bearing wear pattern that becomes more significant with age and hard use. The M3 GTS is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
